title: cleome ornithopodioides subsp. cypria
intro: Cleome ornithopodioides subsp. cypria, commonly known as the Cyprus spider flower, is a species of flowering plant in the Cleomaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that may help to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cleome ornithopodioides subsp. cypria include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, and its antiseptic properties, which may aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
